description: Boundary coverage for extracting the canonical owner/repository identifier from HTTPS Git remote URLs. Exercises a repository name that carries the version-control suffix, a path with a trailing separator, a path that contains additional segments beyond the owner and name, an authority component that bundles embedded credentials together with an explicit port, a path holding only a single segment, and a bare host with an empty path. The input is a single URL string and the output is whatever follows the leading slash of the URL path.
